verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Tavily returns structured per-result objects: search exposes `results[].content`, and Extract places successful URLs in `results` with per-URL failures in `failed_results`. That implies source URLs travel with results, but nothing documents title or published-date fields, or that URLs are canonical. missing for 10: documented title field on search results, documented published_date field, evidence that returned URLs are canonical, independent or hands-on corroboration of citation metadata accuracy.
